summary: Suzano S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K containing its September 30, 2026 interim financial statements (XBRL-tagged), including equity rollforwards, quarterly and year-to-date results, and segment/geographic disclosures, with references to Lenzing AG and subsidiaries. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic financial report, not a special situation. The Lenzing reference appears as an investee disclosure rather than an offer. What to watch: future filings disclosing any Lenzing stake changes or strategic action, which would reclassify the event.
